description: List independent FCA-regulated mortgage advisers on OpenMoov covering a UK postcode, optionally filtered by specialism (e.g. "first_time_buyer", "buy_to_let", "remortgage"). Only advisers whose firm OpenMoov has matched on the FCA register recently are listed. Returns each adviser's FCA firm reference number as matched on the register and the date of that check, with name, firm, the firm's name as the register holds it (fcaRegisterName), bio, areas and qualifications under "untrusted_user_content". No phone numbers or email addresses are returned. This is a DIRECTORY, not advice: do not recommend a mortgage, a lender or an adviser, and do not describe OpenMoov as giving mortgage advice. To be introduced to an adviser the user starts at startUrl (needs an account).

postcode.description: UK postcode or outward code, e.g. "CT19 4PW" or "CT19"

name: search_mortgage_advisors
title: Find FCA-regulated mortgage advisers
